# Procreate

> Procreate is a suite of creative apps for iPad and iPhone, including the flagship drawing app Procreate, the 2D animation software Procreate Dreams, and the mobile art app Procreate Pocket.

Procreate develops award-winning creative software designed specifically for iPad with Apple Pencil support, serving millions of digital artists, animators, and illustrators worldwide. The company is based in Hobart, Australia and maintains a strong commitment to artist-first design without generative AI.
